title: Page 8
slug: 良膳小娘子下-子纹-面对偏心偏到天边去的家人赵小丫这世学聪明了-被当奴婢使唤嫁给傻子换银子的烂事绝不会再发生-娘亲与姊姊
content_zh:
他翻身离开床铺，大步走到外间。

随意的将黑发盘在脑后，赵小丫也跟着出来。

听到脚步声，他微侧过身，对她伸出手。

赵小丫一笑，将手放在他的掌心。

“你才是卫阁老和卫夫人的骨肉。”

察觉掌心里的手一僵，他用力握紧，“说来难以置信，但却是事实。你出世那日，刘彩凤拿自己的儿子把你换了。”

赵小丫一时震惊，只能瞪大眼看他。

他把玩着她的手，没有说话。

赵小丫的心突然顿了一下，有种窒息的感觉，“是……真的？”

周屹天点头，伸手将她抱在怀中。

她静静的任他搂抱，久久才道：“你知道很久了？”

“此次回京前才知。”周屹天微推开她的脸，“可会怪我隐瞒？”

怪吗？她想了一会儿，对亲情，她本就没有期望，她的心始终只系在周屹天一个人身对于彷佛平空出世的亲爹、亲娘，她心中没有太多喜悦，只是吃惊——

是多狠的心，才能拿自己的亲子去换别人家的女儿？

“你急着跟我成亲，便是因为你知道了我的身世？”

周屹天微愣了下，最终在她明亮的目光下点了点头。

“为什么？”她不懂。

“你是我的。”他乌黑的眸子盯着她。

如此霸道……她忍不住失笑，他从不说爱，但是她知道他的爱比任何人都浓烈。他应该是怕她有了卫家后，就不会像以前一样眼中只有他。

“不论我爹娘是谁……”她反手抱住了他的腰，“我都是你的，只会是你的。”

千言万语，只一句便已足够。

卫府不若侯府气派，但是亭台楼阁林立雅致，掌灯时分，在回廊微亮的光晕中别有一番文雅优美。

通往正堂的积雪清理干净，露出方便行走的青石板，再再显示卫府的主子日子过得精细。

赵小丫看着眼前的朱红大门，有片刻失神，但是炽热的温度从紧握的手中传来，让她回过神，她抬头对周屹天露出了抹笑。

亲人什么的，有很好，没有也无妨。在她的心中，所谓的爹、娘都不若眼前的夫君重要，他们才是彼此最重要的亲人。

门房见到来人，立刻要去通报。

周屹天制止了门房，淡淡看着十数个奴仆离了正房一段距离守在外头，他直接大步走了进去。

门房一惊，伸手要拦，却被周屹天一个眼刀给震得留在当场。

厅堂内，刘彩凤披头散发有些狼狈，赵雪则是在一旁哭得委屈。

刘彩凤瞪着宋氏，她从未告诉旁人，打小她最讨厌的人就是这女人——宋彤。

有个有学问的秀才爹，娘亲温柔婉约，只有一个闺女，精心养育，早早就定下个好亲事。

而她却出身屠夫家，唯一能比拚的不过就是家中有点银两，最后她却连这一点都失去。

她嫁进山村，而宋氏却嫁给青梅竹马，进京享福。

多年未见，两人年纪相当，曾经她自傲足以跟宋氏一拚相貌，但今日一见，她心中怨恨。

宋氏年轻貌美，一如当年，而她却被山村的生活折磨得鬓角发白，眼角皱纹横生。

“宋彤，算我瞎了眼。”刘彩凤恨恨的指着宋氏，“当初就不该救你，该让你死在雪地里一了百了。把我捉进卫府？你就是这样对待你的救命恩人不成？”

宋氏的脸皮从年少便薄，被这么指责，脸又红又白，想要开口质问，偏偏原该在护卫营的同儿突然返家，人就坐在一旁，她如何能开口？承认自己确实偏向长子，私心想要相信召儿所言，但……

宋氏最终只能紧握颤抖的手，隐忍的看向自己的夫君。

卫阁老抿着唇不发一言。

当年宋氏产子凶险，昏迷过去，事实如何只有刘家人知情，就算如今刘彩凤在跟前，他们问得再多，只要刘彩凤一口咬定不是，他们也无处可查。

虽说他也喜欢赵小丫这个姑娘，但是召儿所言太过荒谬。

偷梁换柱，怀胎十月，如何能舍？

他的目光落在刘彩凤身上，虽宋氏提及幼时曾在私塾遇见，但他对此人并无一丝印象。

刘彩凤对上他的目光，哭得更是凄凉，“卫大人，这都是什么事？我就是上京来看看我家阿雪，却被卫府的家丁抓伤，你可得为我做主。”

她直接拉开衣袖，露出上头的红肿痕迹。

卫阁老眉头轻皱，基于礼教，移开眼眸，看向卫元召，“到底怎么回事？”

卫元召怒不可遏的瞪着刘彩凤，“若你不逃，我何必让人将你拿下？少拿恩情说事。老实交代，我娘亲生产那日，真的生的是男胎，而不是女娃？”

刘彩凤的心一个咯噔，随即像是疯了似的吼道：“这说的是什么话？宋彤生的就是个儿子，手腕还有胎记，我记得牢牢的。”

“那你呢？”卫元召追问：“同一日产子，你又生下什么？”

刘彩凤又哭又吼，“宋彤生子的那日，我为了帮她，害得我自个儿也提早生了，伤了身子，再也生不出孩子，你们卫家还好意思提这事儿！我就生了个女的，一个贱奴，下贱胚子！”

卫元召气得满脸涨红，姑且不论赵小丫是否真是自己的亲妹妹，单听她这样辱骂就让他想甩她一巴掌。

原本坐在一旁满脸不快的卫昭同再也忍不住，用力一击桌面站起身。

一声巨响令卫阁老不快的斥了一句，“你这是做什么？没有规矩。”

“没规矩的是他！”卫昭同指着卫元召的鼻子大吼，“你怎么不骂他？他说的是什么话？言下之意是说我不是娘生的，是这个下贱村妇生的？”

刘彩凤的哭声一顿，最后哭得更大声。

卫元召的太阳穴隐隐抽痛，唇抿了抿，最终老实回答，“我确实这么以为。”

卫昭同的怒火爆发，七日前他被扭进护卫营，做的是最低下的火头兵，成天疲累狼狈，好不容易今日突然被交代可以返家，他兴冲冲的回府，却连换身衣服、好好吃上一顿的时间都不给，直接被拖到厅里，听着卫元召说自己是低贱村妇所生。

“卫元召，我忍你很久了。”卫昭同赤红着脸，“我今天一定要打死你！”

看到他像疯了似的冲向卫元召，宋氏惊得倒抽了一口气。

卫阁老站起身，正要斥责，却见一道黑影从门外而来。

卫昭同惨叫一声，跌坐回椅子上.。

转瞬间的变故令厅内诡异一静。彷佛无事发生的周屹天淡淡的转过身，走到门口小心翼翼的牵着赵小丫走了进来。

刘彩凤在看到周屹天时，眼泪已吓得流不出来，再看到进门的赵小丫，脸色一下惨白。

宋氏一看到赵小丫，心头一阵激动。

赵小丫目光对上宋氏，看着她眼中水光闪动，不由得心中一软，对她一笑。

宋氏一见眼泪便落了下来，就算赵小丫不是她的闺女，但终究是个极好的善良姑娘。

周屹天扫过厅堂中的每张脸，最后落在卫元召的脸上，冷冷一哼，“没用。”

卫元召瞪了他一眼，“你有用的话你倒是说说，如何让她老实交代？”

“打就成了。”周峻天可不兴那套君子动口不动手。

卫元召听他说得理所当然，一时哑口。

“卫阁老。”周屹天将卫小丫扶坐到一旁，自己也跟着坐了下来，“不如稍待片刻，等人都来齐了再说吧。”

他那气势彷佛这里是侯府而不是卫府。

卫阁老眉头微皱，但碍于周屹天的身分，终究是忍了下来。
content_en:
He rolled off the bed and strode outside.

Zhao Xiaoya casually tied her black hair behind her head and followed her out.

Hearing the footsteps, he turned slightly and stretched out his hand to her.

Zhao Xiaoya smiled and put her hand in his palm.

"You are the flesh and blood of Mr. Wei Ge and Mrs. Wei."

Realizing that the hand in his palm was stiff, he clenched it tightly, "It's unbelievable, but it's true. On the day you were born, Liu Caifeng replaced you with his own son."

Zhao Xiaoya was shocked for a moment and could only stare at him with wide eyes.

He played with her hand and said nothing.

Zhao Xiaoya's heart suddenly paused, and she felt like she was suffocating, "Is it...really?"

Zhou Yitian nodded and reached out to hold her in his arms.

She quietly let him hug her, and then said for a long time: "Have you known this for a long time?"

"I didn't find out until I returned to Beijing this time." Zhou Yitian pushed her face away slightly, "Do you blame me for hiding it?"

Weird?She thought for a while. She had no expectations for family affection. Her heart was always tied to Zhou Yitian alone. She didn't have much joy in her heart for her biological father and mother who seemed to have appeared out of thin air. She was just surprised——

How cruel must you be to trade your own child for someone else's daughter?

"You are so anxious to get married to me because you know my life experience?"

Zhou Yitian was stunned for a moment, and finally nodded under her bright eyes.

"Why?" She didn't understand.

"You are mine." His dark eyes stared at her.

So domineering... She couldn't help laughing. He never said he loved her, but she knew that his love was stronger than anyone else's.He should be afraid that after she has the Wei family, she won't only have eyes for him like before.

"No matter who my parents are..." She hugged his waist with her backhand, "I am yours and will only be yours."

There are thousands of words to say, but just one sentence is enough.

The Wei Mansion is not as grand as the Hou Mansion, but there are many elegant pavilions and pavilions. When the lamp is turned on, the dim halo of the cloister has a special elegance and grace.

The snow leading to the main hall was cleared, revealing a bluestone slab for easy walking, which once again showed that the master of the Wei Mansion lived a meticulous life.

Zhao Xiaoya looked at the vermilion door in front of her and was lost for a moment, but the hot temperature came from her clenched hands and brought her back to reality. She raised her head and smiled at Zhou Yitian.

Relatives and such are nice to have, but it’s okay not to have them.In her heart, the so-called father and mother are not as important as the husband in front of her. They are each other's most important relatives.

When the concierge saw someone coming, he immediately went to report it.

Zhou Yitian stopped the concierge and watched calmly as a dozen servants stood some distance away from the main room and stood outside. He strode in directly.

The concierge was startled and reached out to stop him, but was stunned by Zhou Yitian's glare and stayed on the spot.

In the hall, Liu Caifeng looked a little embarrassed with disheveled hair, while Zhao Xue was crying aggrievedly on the side.

Liu Caifeng glared at Mrs. Song. She had never told anyone that the person she hated the most since she was a child was this woman - Song Tong.

I have a father who is a scholar and a scholar, and a mother who is gentle and graceful. She has only one daughter. She raised her carefully and made a good marriage early.

But she was born into a butcher's family, and the only thing she could compete with was a little money at home, but in the end she lost even this.

She married into a mountain village, but Song married his childhood sweetheart and went to Beijing to enjoy happiness.

They hadn't seen each other for many years, and they were about the same age. She was once proud that she could match Song's looks, but when they met today, she felt resentful.

Mrs. Song is as young and beautiful as ever, but she has been tortured by life in the mountain village to the point where her temples have turned white and her eyes have wrinkles.

"Song Tong, consider me blind." Liu Caifeng pointed at Mrs. Song bitterly, "I shouldn't have saved you in the first place. I should have let you die in the snow. Capture me into the Wei Mansion? Isn't this how you treat your savior?"

Song's face has been thin since she was young. After being accused like this, her face turned red and white. She wanted to ask questions, but her colleague who was supposed to be in the guard camp suddenly returned home and was sitting nearby. How could she speak?He admitted that he did prefer the eldest son, and selfishly wanted to believe what Zhao'er said, but...

In the end, Mrs. Song could only hold her trembling hands tightly and look at her husband forbearingly.

Mr. Wei Ge pursed his lips and said nothing.

Back then, the Song family was in danger of giving birth and fell into a coma. Only the Liu family knew the truth. Even if Liu Caifeng was here now, no matter how many questions they asked, as long as Liu Caifeng insisted that it was not the case, they would have nowhere to find out.

Although he also liked the girl Zhao Xiaoya, what Zhao'er said was too ridiculous.

How can I give up after being pregnant for ten months?

His eyes fell on Liu Caifeng. Although Mr. Song mentioned that he had met him in a private school when he was young, he had no impression of this person.

Liu Caifeng met his gaze and cried even more miserably, "Master Wei, what is all this? I just came to the capital to see my family A Xue, but I was scratched by a servant of the Wei Mansion. You have to make the decision for me."

She directly opened her sleeves, revealing the red and swollen marks on her head.

Old Wei Ge frowned slightly, and based on ethics, he moved his eyes and looked at Wei Yuanzhao, "What's going on?"

Wei Yuanzhao glared at Liu Caifeng angrily, "If you don't run away, why should I let people take you down? Stop talking about favors. Tell me honestly, on the day my mother gave birth, she really gave birth to a boy, not a girl?"

Liu Caifeng's heart skipped a beat, and then she shouted as if she was crazy: "What are you talking about? Song Tong gave birth to a son, and there is a birthmark on his wrist. I remember it firmly."

"What about you?" Wei Yuanzhao asked: "I gave birth to a baby on the same day, what else did you give birth to?"

Liu Caifeng cried and yelled, "On the day Song Tong gave birth, in order to help her, I gave birth early myself, which hurt my body and made me unable to give birth to another child. How dare you Wei family mention this! I gave birth to a girl, a lowly slave, a lowly embryo!"

Wei Yuanzhao's face turned red with anger. Regardless of whether Zhao Xiaoya was really his biological sister, just hearing her insults made him want to slap her.

Wei Zhaotong, who was sitting aside with an unhappy face, couldn't bear it anymore and hit the table hard to stand up.

A loud noise made Mr. Wei Ge scold him unhappily, "What are you doing? There are no rules."

"He is the one who has no rules!" Wei Zhaotong pointed at Wei Yuanzhao's nose and yelled, "Why don't you scold him? What did he say? Does he mean that I was not born to my mother, but to this lowly village woman?"

Liu Caifeng's crying stopped, and finally she cried louder.

Wei Yuanzhao's temples ached slightly, he pursed his lips, and finally answered honestly, "I do think so."

Wei Zhaotong's anger broke out. Seven days ago, he was twisted into the guard camp and worked as the lowest fire soldier. He was tired and embarrassed all day long. Today, he was suddenly told that he could go home. He returned home happily, but he was not even given time to change clothes or have a good meal. He was dragged directly into the hall and listened to Wei Yuanzhao say that he was born to a lowly village woman.

"Wei Yuanzhao, I have tolerated you for a long time." Wei Zhaotong blushed, "I will definitely beat you to death today!"

Seeing him rushing towards Wei Yuanzhao like crazy, Mrs. Song gasped in shock.

Mr. Wei Ge stood up and was about to reprimand when he saw a black shadow coming from outside the door.

Wei Zhaotong screamed and fell back on his chair.

The sudden change caused an eerie silence in the hall.As if nothing happened, Zhou Yitian turned around calmly, walked to the door and carefully led Zhao Xiaoya in.

When Liu Caifeng saw Zhou Yitian, she was so frightened that she couldn't shed tears. When she saw Zhao Xiaoya coming in, her face turned pale.

When Mrs. Song saw Zhao Xiaoya, she felt excited.

Zhao Xiaoya's eyes met Song's, and when she saw the water in her eyes flashing, she couldn't help but feel soft in her heart and smiled at her.

Mrs. Song shed tears as soon as she saw her. Even though Zhao Xiaoya was not her daughter, she was still an extremely kind-hearted girl.

Zhou Yitian scanned every face in the hall, finally landing on Wei Yuanzhao's face, and snorted coldly, "It's useless."

Wei Yuanzhao glared at him, "If it's useful to you, you can tell me how to make her confess honestly?"

"Just beat him." Zhou Juntian didn't like that gentleman's words but not his actions.

Wei Yuanzhao was speechless for a moment after hearing what he said.

"Mr. Wei Ge." Zhou Yitian helped Wei Xiaoya sit aside and sat down himself, "Why don't we wait for a while and wait until everyone is here."

His aura seemed as if this was a Hou Mansion rather than a Wei Mansion.

Old Wei Ge frowned slightly, but due to Zhou Yitian's identity, he finally endured it.
